notes:
Handwritten text leaf; thin later foliation 27 at the bottom left (not identified as his manuscript pagination). The page begins with a fully cancelled continuation and develops Corollaire 2, conditions c), d), and a cancelled e). Its working revisions move the characteristic-zero/normality assumptions above the cases, add the Artin condition to c), and the algebraic-group embedding to d). There are no diagrams: the large loops across e) and the boxed note are cancellation marks. The principal new secure correction to C is the cancellation state of the boxed marginal note; its words remain doubtful. The lower asterisk note explicitly records work still needed for complete curves of genus at least 2: central triviality and absence of finite-order elements, with a fallback to non-complete successive fibres. The barred m is a retained abbreviation for même. Several new proposed readings under cancellation (boxed-note words and the short lower fragment after X normal) are low-confidence proposals for main-reader adjudication, not resolved doubts. The old phrase de même/des variétés is intentionally left open. The end punctuation is not balanced or regularized. lines_read counts body, insertions, and oblique marginal baseline units approximately; all were read from the supplied full page and both halves.

[Blind audit] All fourteen boxes were viewed. The d) clause has a two-part semicolon after (1); the boxed note ends with a descending comma. The cancelled phrase des variétés / de même X aurait is placed after un and before cas particulier, following its interlinear position. The flat a in the crossed opening, X normal / X admet, on / un, the last map endpoint, the surj stop, and three compressed marginal endings remain doubtful. The blind omission of f=g is not adopted: its f descender, equality bars and g body survive at the upper box edge and were already seen in the original page. The other added contexts and wrapper differences do not change the page.
